# Error registry

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask errors` from each crate's src/error.rs.
     Do not edit by hand: CI runs `cargo xtask errors --check`. -->

Every entrypoint returns `Result<_, Error>`. A failed call surfaces as
`Error(Contract, #<code>)` in the transaction result, and as
`Err(Ok(Error::<Name>))` from a Rust `try_*` client call. Codes are
per contract: look the code up under the contract you called.

Codes are append-only. A variant's code is never renumbered or
reused, so a client built against an older spec still maps every
code it knows.

## Shared codes (100 and up)

Codes from 100 up come from the shared `zenith-common` frameworks
(storage migrations and upgrade safety). They mean the same thing in
every contract that defines them.

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause | Defined in |
|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | `SchemaVersionMismatch` | `from` isn't the stored schema version. | `migrate(from, to)` with a stale `from`, including repeating a finished step. | `governor`, `grants_escrow`, `multisig`, `params`, `staking`, `streams` |
| 101 | `InvalidMigrationTarget` | The migration target is invalid. | `migrate` with `to <= from`, or `to` beyond what the running wasm can migrate to. | `governor`, `grants_escrow`, `multisig`, `params`, `staking`, `streams` |
| 102 | `MigrationInProgress` | A storage migration is unfinished, so state-changing entrypoints are closed. | A paginated `migrate` still needs `migrate_batch`, or the wasm was upgraded and `migrate` hasn't run. | `governor`, `grants_escrow`, `multisig`, `params`, `staking`, `streams` |
| 103 | `NoMigrationInProgress` | No paginated migration is in flight. | `migrate_batch` when nothing is in progress. | `governor`, `grants_escrow`, `multisig`, `params`, `staking`, `streams` |
| 104 | `InvalidMigrationBatch` | The migration batch is invalid. | `migrate_batch` with a cursor other than where the last batch stopped, or a limit of 0 or above `MAX_MIGRATION_BATCH`. | `governor`, `grants_escrow`, `multisig`, `params`, `staking`, `streams` |
| 105 | `WasmNotProposed` | The wasm hash isn't on the upgrade allowlist. | `upgrade` / cancel for a hash that was never proposed, or was cancelled or already installed. | `multisig` |
| 106 | `UpgradeNotMatured` | The allowlisted wasm hash isn't installable yet. | `upgrade` before the hash's `not_before`. | `multisig` |
| 107 | `WasmAlreadyProposed` | The wasm hash is already allowlisted. | Proposing a hash that is already on the allowlist. | `multisig` |
| 108 | `UpgradeCheckPending` | The post-upgrade self-check hasn't passed, so user-facing entrypoints are closed. | The wasm was upgraded and `post_upgrade_check` hasn't been called, or it failed (see `upgrade_check_failed`). | `multisig` |
| 109 | `NoUpgradeCheckPending` | No upgrade is awaiting a self-check. | `post_upgrade_check` when no upgrade is pending a check. | `multisig` |

## governor

`Error` in [governor/src/error.rs](../governor/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The governor is already initialized. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `InvalidProposal` | The proposal's action lists are invalid. | `propose` with no actions, more than `MAX_ACTIONS`, or `targets`/`fns`/`args` of different lengths. |
| 3 | `ProposalExists` | A proposal with the same id already exists. | `propose` with the same actions and description hash as an existing proposal. |
| 4 | `ProposalNotFound` | No proposal has this id. | An entrypoint called with an id `propose` never returned. |
| 5 | `BelowProposalThreshold` | The proposer's voting power is below the proposal threshold. | `propose` from an account with fewer past votes than `proposal_threshold`. |
| 6 | `InvalidState` | The proposal isn't in a state that allows this call. | Voting outside `Active`, queueing a proposal that hasn't `Succeeded`, or cancelling a finished one. |
| 7 | `AlreadyVoted` | This voter already voted on this proposal. | A second `cast_vote` / `cast_vote_by_sig` by the same voter. |
| 8 | `InvalidSupport` | The vote's `support` value is invalid. | `support` other than 0 (Against), 1 (For) or 2 (Abstain). |
| 9 | `OutOfBounds` | A governance parameter is outside its allowed range. | `initialize` or a `set_*` call with a value outside the documented bounds. |
| 10 | `Unauthorized` | The caller may not cancel this proposal. | `cancel` by someone other than the proposer of a `Pending` proposal while the proposer still meets the threshold. |
| 11 | `NotInitialized` | The governor isn't initialized. | Calling an entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 12 | `MathOverflow` | An arithmetic result doesn't fit its type. | Vote tallies above `i128::MAX`, a quorum computation overflowing, or ledger arithmetic past `u32::MAX`. |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104.

## grants_escrow

`Error` in [grants_escrow/src/error.rs](../grants_escrow/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `InvalidMilestones` | The milestone list is invalid. | `create_grant` with no milestones, more than `MAX_MILESTONES`, a non-positive amount, a deadline not in the future, or amounts summing past `i128::MAX`. |
| 2 | `InvalidReviewers` | The reviewer committee is invalid. | `create_grant` with no reviewers, more than `MAX_REVIEWERS`, or a duplicate reviewer. |
| 3 | `InvalidQuorum` | The quorum is invalid. | `create_grant` with a quorum of 0 or above the number of reviewers. |
| 4 | `ReviewerIsGrantee` | The grantee can't review their own grant. | `create_grant` listing the grantee among the reviewers. |
| 5 | `GrantNotFound` | No grant has this id. | An entrypoint called with a `grant_id` that was never created. |
| 6 | `MilestoneNotFound` | The grant has no milestone at this index. | `submit_milestone` / `approve_milestone` with `idx` past the last milestone. |
| 7 | `InvalidMilestoneState` | The milestone isn't in the state this call needs. | Submitting a milestone that isn't `Pending`, or approving one that isn't `Submitted`. |
| 8 | `DeadlinePassed` | The milestone's deadline has passed. | `submit_milestone` after the milestone's deadline. |
| 9 | `NotAReviewer` | The caller isn't on this grant's reviewer committee. | `approve_milestone` from an address not in the grant's `reviewers`. |
| 10 | `AlreadyApproved` | This reviewer already approved this milestone. | A reviewer calling `approve_milestone` twice for the same milestone. |
| 11 | `NothingToReclaim` | No milestone is reclaimable yet. | `reclaim` before any unreleased milestone is `GRACE_PERIOD` past its deadline. |
| 12 | `MathOverflow` | An arithmetic result doesn't fit its type. | The grant counter overflowing `u64`. |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104.

## lp_pool

`Error` in [lp_pool/src/error.rs](../lp_pool/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The pool is already initialized. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `NotInitialized` | The pool isn't initialized. | Calling an entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 3 | `InvalidAmount` | The amount is invalid, or a share/asset conversion overflowed. | A non-positive amount, a negative cap or liability mark, or values so large that a conversion exceeds `i128::MAX`. |
| 4 | `InsufficientShares` | The user holds fewer shares than requested. | `request_withdraw` for more shares than the user's balance. |
| 5 | `SeriesNotWhitelisted` | The series isn't whitelisted. | `write_option` into a series whose cap is zero (never set, or de-listed). |
| 6 | `SeriesCapExceeded` | The series' collateral cap would be exceeded. | `write_option` locking more collateral in a series than its cap allows. |
| 7 | `UtilizationCapExceeded` | The pool-wide utilization cap would be exceeded. | `write_option` pushing `locked / (idle + locked)` above `max_utilization_bps`. |
| 8 | `InsufficientIdle` | The pool doesn't have enough idle assets. | `write_option` needing more collateral than is idle. |
| 9 | `PositionsStillOpen` | Positions are still open. | `process_epoch` before every open position has been reclaimed. |
| 10 | `PositionNotFound` | The pool has no open position with this id. | `reclaim` for a position that was never written or was already reclaimed. |
| 11 | `InvalidUtilization` | The utilization cap is invalid. | `initialize` / `set_max_utilization` with 0 or more than 10_000 bps. |
| 12 | `TooManyPositions` | The open-position list is full. | `write_option` with `MAX_POSITIONS` positions already open. |
| 13 | `BelowMinimumDeposit` | The deposit is below the minimum. | `deposit` of less than `MIN_DEPOSIT`. |
| 14 | `MathOverflow` | A balance-delta computation doesn't fit its type. | Token balances moving by more than `i128::MAX` during a market call. |
| 15 | `EpochNotProcessed` | A ticket refers to an epoch with no stored result. | An epoch result that was never written or has been archived; restore it before claiming. |

## lp_token

`Error` in [lp_token/src/error.rs](../lp_token/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The token already has a pool. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `NotInitialized` | The token has no pool yet. | `mint`, `pool` or a metadata read before `initialize`. |
| 3 | `NegativeAmount` | Amounts can't be negative. | A transfer, approval, mint or burn with a negative amount. |
| 4 | `InsufficientBalance` | The balance is too low. | Transferring or burning more than the holder's balance. |
| 5 | `InsufficientAllowance` | The allowance is too low. | `transfer_from` / `burn_from` for more than the spender's unexpired allowance. |
| 6 | `InvalidExpiration` | The allowance expiration is in the past. | `approve` with a nonzero amount and an `expiration_ledger` before the current ledger. |
| 7 | `InvalidDecimals` | The decimals don't fit a `u8`. | `initialize` with `decimal` above 255. |
| 8 | `Overflow` | A balance would exceed `i128::MAX`. | Minting or transferring into a balance close to `i128::MAX`. |

## multisig

`Error` in [multisig/src/error.rs](../multisig/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The multisig is already initialized. | Calling `initialize` / `initialize_weighted` a second time. |
| 2 | `InvalidThreshold` | A threshold is invalid for the signer set. | A threshold of 0 or above the total weight, a rotation threshold not above the threshold (unless unanimous) or above the total weight, or an empty signer set. |
| 3 | `DuplicateSigner` | The address is already a signer. | Initializing with a repeated signer, or a signer change adding an existing signer. |
| 4 | `NotASigner` | The address isn't a signer. | A signer-only entrypoint called by a non-signer, or a signer change removing a non-signer. |
| 5 | `AlreadyApproved` | This signer already has a fresh approval of this action (or upgrade). | `approve` / `approve_upgrade` twice by the same signer. |
| 6 | `NotYetApproved` | The action isn't approved (or this signer has no approval to revoke). | `execute`, `reset`, `queue_signer_change` or `execute_signer_change` below the required weight, or `revoke` / `revoke_upgrade` without a fresh approval. |
| 7 | `InvalidDelays` | Reserved: the delays are invalid. | Not currently returned. |
| 8 | `AccountNotConfigured` | Reserved: the custom-account configuration is missing. | Not currently returned. |
| 9 | `UnsortedSignatures` | Reserved: signatures aren't sorted by signer. | Not currently returned. |
| 10 | `InsufficientSignatures` | Reserved: not enough signatures. | Not currently returned. |
| 11 | `ContextNotAllowed` | Reserved: the authorization context isn't allowed. | Not currently returned. |
| 12 | `ActionAlreadyRegistered` | The action is already registered (or queued). | `register_action` for a pending, executed or vetoed action, or `queue_signer_change` twice. |
| 13 | `ActionNotPending` | The action isn't pending. | Approving, executing, vetoing or expiring an action that was executed, reset, expired or vetoed, or never registered. |
| 14 | `TooManyPendingActions` | The pending-action index is full. | Registering an action when `MAX_PENDING_ACTIONS` are pending, or the proposer already has `MAX_PENDING_PER_SIGNER`. |
| 15 | `ProposalNotFound` | No proposal has this id. | `execute` with an id `propose` never returned. |
| 16 | `ProposalTooLarge` | The proposal has too many arguments. | `propose` with more than `MAX_PROPOSAL_ARGS` arguments. |
| 17 | `InvalidPageLimit` | The page or batch size is invalid. | `get_pending_actions` with a limit of 0 or above `MAX_PAGE_LIMIT`, or `prune` with more than `MAX_PRUNE` ids. |
| 18 | `NotExpired` | The action can't be expired yet. | `expire` with no approval TTL configured, before the action is older than it, or while an approval is still fresh. |
| 19 | `InvalidWeight` | A signer weight is zero. | Initializing or adding a signer with weight 0. |
| 20 | `WeightOverflow` | The total signer weight doesn't fit a `u32`. | Weights summing past `u32::MAX`. |
| 21 | `InvalidSignerChange` | The signer change is malformed. | `propose_signer_change` adding or removing more than one signer. |
| 22 | `SignerChangeNotFound` | No signer change has this id. | Queueing, vetoing or executing an id `propose_signer_change` never returned. |
| 23 | `StaleSignerChange` | The signer change was proposed under an older signer set. | Queueing or executing a change after another change already executed. |
| 24 | `RotationDelayActive` | The rotation delay hasn't elapsed. | `execute_signer_change` before the queued change's ready time. |
| 25 | `SignerChangeNotQueued` | The signer change isn't queued. | `execute_signer_change` without a prior `queue_signer_change`. |
| 26 | `TooManySigners` | The signer set is too large. | More than `MAX_SIGNERS` signers. |
| 27 | `NotVetoer` | The caller isn't the vetoer. | `veto` from an address other than the one `set_vetoer` stored (or before one is set). |
| 28 | `VetoerAlreadySet` | The vetoer is already set. | A second `set_vetoer`. |
| 29 | `InvalidDeadline` | The deadline isn't in the future. | `set_execute_by` with a timestamp at or before now. |
| 30 | `NotProposer` | The caller didn't propose this action. | `set_execute_by` from someone other than the action's proposer. |
| 31 | `DeadlineAlreadySet` | The action already has a deadline. | A second `set_execute_by` for the same action. |
| 32 | `NotInitialized` | The multisig isn't initialized. | Calling an entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 33 | `UpgradeNotUnanimous` | Not every signer has approved this wasm. | `upgrade` when a signer hasn't approved the hash (or a signer was added since unanimity). |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109.

## params

`Error` in [params/src/error.rs](../params/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The registry already has a timelock. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `ParamNotFound` | No parameter is defined under this key. | `set_param`, `get_value` or a bounds call for a key `define_param` never created. |
| 3 | `ParamAlreadyDefined` | A parameter already exists under this key. | `define_param` for a key that is already defined; use `set_param`. |
| 4 | `OutOfBounds` | The value is outside the parameter's `[min, max]` bounds. | `set_param` / `define_param` with an out-of-range value, or bounds that exclude the current value. |
| 5 | `InvalidBounds` | `min` is greater than `max`. | `define_param` or `propose_bounds` with inverted bounds. |
| 6 | `NoPendingBounds` | No bounds change is queued for this key. | `execute_bounds` / `cancel_bounds` without a prior `propose_bounds`. |
| 7 | `BoundsDelayNotElapsed` | The queued bounds change isn't executable yet. | `execute_bounds` before `BOUNDS_CHANGE_DELAY` has passed since `propose_bounds`. |
| 8 | `NotInitialized` | The registry has no timelock yet. | Calling a timelock-gated entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 9 | `MathOverflow` | An arithmetic result doesn't fit its type. | A bounds `eta` past `u64::MAX`, or the version counter overflowing. |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104.

## staking

`Error` in [staking/src/error.rs](../staking/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The contract is already initialized. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `InvalidAmount` | The amount must be above zero. | `stake`, `request_unstake` or `notify_reward` with an amount of 0 or less. |
| 3 | `InsufficientStake` | The user has less stake than requested. | `request_unstake` for more than the user's earning stake. |
| 4 | `NothingToWithdraw` | The user has no pending unstake. | `withdraw` without a prior `request_unstake`, or after it was already withdrawn. |
| 5 | `CooldownActive` | The unstake cooldown hasn't elapsed. | `withdraw` before the pending unstake's `unlock_at`. |
| 6 | `TooManyRewardTokens` | The reward-token cap is reached. | `notify_reward` with a new token when `MAX_REWARD_TOKENS` tokens are already tracked. |
| 7 | `NotInitialized` | The contract isn't initialized. | Calling an entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 8 | `MathOverflow` | An arithmetic result doesn't fit its type. | A stake, reward or accumulator value exceeding `i128::MAX`, or a cooldown pushing `unlock_at` past `u64::MAX`. |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104.

## streams

`Error` in [streams/src/error.rs](../streams/src/error.rs).

| Code | Name | Meaning | Typical cause |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `AlreadyInitialized` | The contract is already initialized. | Calling `initialize` a second time. |
| 2 | `InvalidAmount` | The amount must be above zero. | `create_stream` with a non-positive total, or `withdraw` of 0 or less. |
| 3 | `InvalidSchedule` | The schedule is invalid. | `create_stream` with `start >= end`, or a cliff before `start` or after `end`. |
| 4 | `StreamNotFound` | No stream has this id. | An entrypoint called with a `stream_id` that was never created. |
| 5 | `Unauthorized` | The caller may not cancel this stream. | `cancel` from an address that is neither the stream's funder nor governance. |
| 6 | `InsufficientBalance` | The recipient has less accrued than requested. | `withdraw` for more than `balance_of(stream_id).0`. |
| 7 | `StreamCanceled` | The stream was cancelled. | `cancel` or `transfer` on an already-cancelled stream. |
| 8 | `NotInitialized` | The contract isn't initialized. | Calling an entrypoint before `initialize`. |
| 9 | `MathOverflow` | An arithmetic result doesn't fit its type. | A stream total so large that `total × elapsed` exceeds `i128::MAX`, or the stream counter overflowing. |

Also defines shared codes 100, 101, 102, 103, 104.
